Q: Mapping image brightness to a fixed set of user-selected colors in WinForms A:

You can refactor the if/else part to a switch statement. There is good explanation and example that fits your use case here: Switch case: can I use a range instead of a one number

Not that there is anything particularly wrong with what you already have. It may be a little verbose but it is easy to follow and understand. Changing to a switch statement is unlikely to make any difference to how fast it runs.

For info, questions such as these (with respect to your first question about the if/else at least) are often better posted on the Code Review stack exchange site. Strictly speaking they are out of scope here and likely to get closed.

https://codereview.stackexchange.com/

Q: Instagram oEmbed - URL signature mismatch for thumbnail_url A:

What you need to do, is to use the shortlink provided by instagram, you can find this or either via the embed function in the UI or via the API, In the API shows as 'link', then add '/media' at the end, this will redirect to the resource without need to sign the calls.

Hope helps
